./.title: Overview
./.body:
English · 简体中文


Heygo · AI Passport · Project summary
Ask the coach during a rest
AI Passport is a small handheld device for skiers. The user sees the data of the last run and hears the AI coach. The user does not take out the phone or remove the gloves. All 17 sprints of the project are complete.




Sprints17/17
Increments4/4
Decisions33
Requirements24
Screens25
Self-test122/122


What the team delivered

Increment 1Coach voiceA long press of OK opens the Coach page. The user holds OK and asks a question. The phone does speech-to-text, the AI answer, and text-to-speech. The device plays the answer.
Increment 2Run data and reportLive speed, drop, distance, turns, and time. After each run, a Heygo IQ (0 to 200) and one tip. The device opens the live data page at run start.
Increment 3TurnsThe line of each run, 8 turns on each page. The page shows the speed, angle, and radius of each turn.
Increment 4Phone popupsFall alert, voice notice, issue report, and achievement report. A popup opens at once and counts down 10 s. Any key closes it.


Quick answers



Question
Answer
More




What does the device do?
It controls only the keys, microphone, speaker, and screen. The phone does all analysis and voice work.
Architecture and protocol


How does the user operate it?
Four pages at the same level make a loop. A short press of UP or DOWN changes the page. A long press of OK opens the coach.
Product and pages


What does it look like?
25 screens that LVGL renders on the host, and two animations.
Screen gallery


What is the status?
Sprints 0 to 16 are complete.
Sprints


How long did it take?
55 commits on main, from 10-16 18:02 to 10-18 10:48.
Project history


How does the team control quality?
A gate runs before each commit. Host tests, screen checks, and the simulator self-test must pass.
Quality and deployment



Links

Online simulator: https://azuresword.github.io/Heygo-AiPassport/. You can push the device keys in the browser.
Repository: https://github.com/Azuresword/Heygo-AiPassport
The book source is in summary-book/. Run figures.py to make the figures. Then run build.sh to make summary/.

product.html.title: Product and pages
product.html.body:
English · 简体中文

Product

Product and pages
Users and use
A skier uses the device after a run, on the lift or during a rest break. The phone stays in a pocket with Bluetooth on. The user keeps the gloves on and pushes only three physical keys: UP, OK, and DOWN.
Source: 需求文件夹/01-product-requirements.md, lines 12 to 26.
Four pages in one loop
The four pages are at the same level. A short press of DOWN opens the next page. A short press of UP opens the previous page. At the end, the loop starts again (D-29, D-30). A long press of OK on any page opens the Coach page.

How to read the Turns page
On the Turns page, OK selects the next turn. A long press of UP selects the previous turn. A long press of DOWN opens the next page. The device keeps 3 groups of turns. It asks the phone for other groups with TURN_REQUEST.

Events that the phone starts

D-31 · POPUP 0x66PopupA popup stops any state. The device plays the voice and then counts down 10 s. Any key closes the popup. The device then shows the previous page. A new popup replaces an old popup.
D-32 · RUN_START 0x68Run startThe phone finds a run start. The device opens the live data page. During a talk or a popup, the device waits until it ends. A run start cancels nothing.
D-33Page railA rail on the right side shows the position in the loop. A fluorescent green slider shows the current page. ▲ and ▼ show the UP and DOWN targets.

architecture.html.title: Architecture and protocol
architecture.html.body:
English · 简体中文

Architecture

Architecture and protocol
Tasks
The device controls only the keys, microphone, speaker, and screen (D-14). The phone does speech recognition, speech synthesis, run data, and the AI coach. The link is BLE only. The device does not use Wi-Fi (D-08).


Figure 6. System architecture. Hardware source: Firmware/docs/README.md, hardware section.





Item
Value




Controller
ESP32-C3, 8 MB flash, no PSRAM


Screen
ST7789P3, 240 × 320, SPI2


Keys
UP, DOWN, and OK on GPIO0 through an ADC divider


Audio
ES8311, full-duplex I2S


Fuel gauge
CW2017


Software
ESP-IDF 5.5.3, LVGL 9.5.0, NimBLE


Audio codec
IMA ADPCM at 16 kHz in 20 ms blocks. Raw PCM is the fallback (D-09).


Security
No encryption and no pairing (D-12)



Messages for one question


Figure 7. One coach question. The left column shows the device state. Compare it with Figure 4 in the Screen gallery.


Important rule: the phone sends PLAY_START only after it gets AGENT_END (D-20). The device ignores PLAY_START during a recording.
Messages in protocol 0.2
Source: 需求文件夹/07-ble-protocol-draft.md. D is the device. P is the phone.



Group
Message
Direction
Use




Link
HELLO 0x01 · HELLO_ACK 0x02
D↔P
Handshake: versions, codec, and MTU



PHONE_STATUS 0x03 · DEVICE_STATUS 0x04
Both
Network, battery, page, and free heap



ERROR 0x0F
Both
Rejects a packet


Context
CONTEXT 0x10
D→P
Page change


Coach
AGENT_START 0x20 · AGENT_END 0x21 · AGENT_CANCEL 0x22
D→P
Start, end, or cancel one question



AGENT_STATE 0x23
P→D
States such as thinking or failed


Audio
AUDIO_UP 0x30
D→P
Recording blocks



AUDIO_DOWN 0x31 · PLAY_START 0x32 · PLAY_END 0x33
P→D
Playback. Channel 0 is the coach. Channel 2 is a popup.


Run
LIVE_STATS 0x60 · RUN_REPORT 0x61 · RUN_START 0x68
P→D
Live data, report, and run start



SHOW_PAGE 0x62
P→D
Shows the report page


Turns
TURN_SHAPE 0x63 · TURN_GROUP 0x64
P→D
Turn summary and groups



TURN_REQUEST 0x65
D→P
Asks for a missing group


Popup
POPUP 0x66
P→D
Opens a popup at once



POPUP_END 0x67
D→P
The popup closed, with a reason



The protocol also defines team talk (0x50 to 0x55 and PLAY_STOP 0x34). Team talk is P1. It is not in the scope of this delivery.

Gate
At the end of each sprint, ./tools/validate.sh must exit with code 0 (需求文件夹/08-sprint-roadmap.md, section 1).

Step
What it finds




Host tests
33 test_* files in Firmware/tests/, for example link core, Turns page, popup page, and ADPCM codec


Glyph check
Screen text that the font cannot show


host_render
Screen overlap, memory pool leaks, and cut UTF-8 text. It also makes the screens in assets/mockups/.


flow_sim
Differences between the simulator and the state machine. The self-test runs in headless Chrome.



Results that we examined for this book
We ran these checks on 2026-10-18 at main commit d99a7d9:

flow_sim --checkPASS
Simulator self-test122/122


We ran only these two checks. The full gate needs ESP-IDF 5.5.3. This cloud computer does not have it.
Device verification
The team did the board flashing, the phone app tests (TC-01 to TC-24), and the U1 usability test (5 testers) on physical devices. The records of these tests are not in this repository.

Follow-up items
The team delivered the project. This page lists items outside the scope and items that the team did not do on purpose. Use it for the next phase.
Accepted risks
Source: 需求文件夹/04-validation-and-decisions.md, risk table.

D-12No BLE encryptionPeople near the user can hear the audio. The team did not use pairing, to keep the connection simple.
D-18No power managementThis delivery has no power-saving strategy.
D-31Fall popup closes after 10 sThe phone controls the escalation. POPUP_END reason 0 tells the phone that nobody pushed a key.
D-32The phone finds the run startIf the phone is not correct, the device changes the page but cancels nothing. On the live data page, a short press of DOWN opens the report page.


Design limits in the documents
Source: Firmware/docs/heygo-changes.md, known issues.



Limit
Explanation




The screen does not show the battery level

Longer text ends with three dots. The voice plays the full answer.



Possible next work

Basis

The project owner confirmed on 2026-10-18 that Sprints 0 to 16 are complete.
The team did the board flashing, the phone app integration, and the usability test on physical devices. The computer that made this book is a cloud computer. It cannot connect to a device.
